name: daggerheart-backend
description: Express backend for Daggerheart Companion with embedded JSON data

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');fs.mkdirSync('dist/data',{recursive:true});fs.readdirSync('src/data').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.json')).forEach(f=>fs.copyFileSync(path.join('src/data',f),path.join('dist/data',f)));console.log('JSON files copied to dist/data')"
